description: Set of 3 flower bouquets of Gerbera Daisy flowers in a light shade of teal blue! 9 stems per bouquet, for a total of 27 daisy stems. Each sweet hand tied bouquet looks freshly picked from the garden with a natural twine tie holding it together. Each blossom measures a solid 3 inches in diameter with multiple rows of delicate daisy petals. The back calyx is green fabric and the stem is green plastic. We love the high quality blooms with the super low price. This is a great buy for 3 beautiful bouquets! each bouquet measures 7 inch diameter x 10 inches tall.
